pages.text: Tonight was a feast for everyone in the yard. A long table stood in the middle.
Lulu held an armful of plates. "I will put out all the plates."
Aunt Rosa hurried over with flowers. "A feast table must be pretty!"
She laid flowers everywhere and put a big pitcher in the middle.
Lulu tried to set a plate down. No room! The table was a flower garden.
"Please move them a little, Aunt Rosa." "No! They look prettiest here!"
Now Aunt Rosa unrolled ribbons too. There was less and less room for plates.
Lulu brought an empty bottle, gathered the flowers, and stood them inside.
There was room on the table. One plate, two plates—Lulu set them all out to the end.
The flower bottle stood in the middle. Aunt Rosa glanced at it. "...That does look prettier."
